title: The RAPID - PE Study: RESCUE Advanced Protocol for the Treatment of Pulmonary Embolism
official: The RAPID - PE Study: RESCUE Advanced Protocol Without ICU Stay and no Lytic Drip - for the Treatment of Pulmonary Embolism
summary: To demonstrate the efficacy and safety of the 8F BASHIR™ .035 Endovascular Catheter and the 8F BASHIR™ S-B .035 Endovascular Catheter for the administration of pharmaco-mechanical catheter directed therapy using pulse sprays of r-tPA into the pulmonary arteries for the treatment of intermediate risk pulmonary embolism (PE).
